root: ^Another success. Younger donors are the most effective.
^The ridiculous fairytale name in the local news is bad, it garners more attention. I can't keep doing this for long when they're making such a spectacle out of this.
^I need only a bit more. Next one might be the last. Please be the last one...
^I keep seeing their faces and hearing their little grunts when I'm asleep...
^But I'm doing this for Orianna. I can wake the others up too, when I have perfected the cure. Maybe then I'll earn my doctor title again and make history with my research...
